items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: Oh he was one of my good friends. He practiced with me.

ctx.x: Well I remember Boisot had a funny, what did you call it, a wandering bass or something?

Boisot, he had a good left hand. He had sort of a Dixieland bass because he'd go, you know, like that. He filled in his old time bass. I have some nice tapes. He stayed at his place one night and I have about almost an hour of his recordings with nobody around. They're fun. If you ever want to listen to them or copy one of them, be glad to let you copy them.
